items.title: Ask HN: Does anyone else feel like nothing matters anymore?
items.title_cn: 问问HN ：还有其他人觉得什么都不重要了吗？
items.summary: New software releases? Who cares. Learning new CS concepts? Whatever. Studying for the next interview? Job probably won't even exist in a year. Working on that side project? No one will care because it's just another addition to the mountain of slop, and the guy bagging your groceries can do it. Everything is done and cooked with AI now. It's exactly like that feeling once you enable cheats in a game; sure you can do anything, but everything is meaningless now. Our entire purpose and joy in life
items.summary_cn: 新软件发布？谁在乎？学习新的CS概念？随便啦，准备下次面试？工作可能在一年内就不存在了。在那个侧面项目上工作？没有人会关心，因为这只是山坡上的另一个补充，打包生鲜杂货的人可以做到这一点。现在一切都是用AI完成和烹饪的。一旦你在游戏中启用作弊，这种感觉就完全一样；当然你可以做任何事情，但现在一切都变得毫无意义了。我们生活的全部目的和喜悦
items.comment: 又是一个「史上最强」，基准测试刷得飞起，实际应用场景待检验。
